# Databases

This folder catalogs the foundational data repositories and registries that supply clinical, demographic, and organizational information to Danish healthcare quality monitoring systems. It is organized into three distinct areas: specialized clinical registers tracking acute surgical outcomes, national government registers providing civil and organizational infrastructure, and broader healthcare databases contributing anesthesia and laboratory data. Together, these systems form the underlying data architecture that allows quality registries to define patient populations, calculate comorbidities, and measure clinical indicators.

## Pages

- [[entities/databases/clinical/index|Clinical]] — Specialized clinical registries focused on acute and emergency surgical care, including historical predecessors to modern databases.
- [[entities/databases/government/index|Government]] — National government registers providing foundational demographic and organizational data, such as the Civil Registration System and the Healthcare Organizational Register.
- [[entities/databases/healthcare/index|Healthcare]] — National healthcare databases supplying critical clinical and laboratory data, including anesthesia records and national laboratory results.
